Gideon Sato, here's a draft from the #inc-vtg-hartford thread (times are company time, UTC-5, all on Aug 3, 2026):

*Hartford gate check-in incident: summary for Procurement*
• *First report:* 10:42 AM. Both inbound gate kiosk lanes at Vantorre's Hartford plant showed a white screen after badge scan. The guard logged trailers manually in the meantime.
• *Kiosk 1 restored:* 11:03 AM. The guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it.
• *Both lanes confirmed working:* 11:07 AM.

Scheduling from the dispatch office was unaffected; this was gate check-in only. The separate status-page access issue is still being chased under ticket INC-4821.

Note: the kiosk 1 time is Mateo's own report in the incident room, and the 11:07 confirmation is yours. I haven't sent this to anyone. If you want it emailed to Mateo's team, tell me and I'll check the addresses first, since anything going outside pemberline.com needs Ruth Calloway's approval.
